description: At the end of a quiet lane in Sausalito's coveted Willows enclave, 1 Willow Lane presents a rare offeringan end-unit residence that lives with the privacy and presence of a single-family home. Light-filled and thoughtfully designed, the interiors balance volume, comfort, and understated sophistication.    Vaulted ceilings create an airy sense of scale across the main living spaces, while rich floors add warmth and continuity. Two private patios extend the living experience outdoorsideal for morning coffee, intimate dining, or quiet moments surrounded by greenery. The kitchen is both refined and functional, anchored by a built-in refrigerator and a clean, modern aesthetic.    The floor plan offers exceptional versatility. A generous main-level bedroom with a walk-in closet provides ease and flexibility for guests or everyday living. Upstairs, the ensuite primary suite is a peaceful retreat, complete with its own walk-in closet. An additional bonus room adapts seamlessly as a home office, nursery, or creative space, complemented by a dedicated laundry room.    Set within one of Sausalito's most desirable communities, The Willows offers a rare blend of privacy and convenience, just moments from waterfront paths, local dining, and a seamless commute to San Francisco. Residents also enjoy access to a community pool & hot tub, enhancing the relaxed, resort-like setting.    Refined, private, and effortlessly livablethis is elevated Sausalito living.
